name: YouTube
description: The world's largest video platform. Music, tutorials, creators, live streams and long-form shows, with recommendations that learn what you like.

name: Netflix
description: Subscription streaming with original series, films and documentaries. Profiles keep everyone's watch list separate.

name: Twitch
tagline: Live streams for gaming and more
description: Live streaming built around chat. Game streams, music, art, talk shows and esports, with a community around every channel.

name: Prime Video
description: Movies, series and live sports included with Amazon Prime, plus channels and rentals on top.

name: Disney+
tagline: Disney, Pixar, Marvel and Star Wars
description: The Disney catalog in one place: animated classics, Marvel and Star Wars series, Pixar films and National Geographic.

name: Facebook
description: The original social network. Groups, events, Marketplace and a feed of what the people you know are up to.

name: Instagram
description: Share photos and short videos, follow creators and keep up with friends through Stories and direct messages.

name: X
description: Short posts in real time. Follow people and topics, join conversations and catch breaking news as it unfolds.

name: Reddit
description: Thousands of communities, each with its own posts, votes and discussion. From niche hobbies to world news.

name: LinkedIn
description: Professional profiles, job listings, company pages and industry news. Where careers get built and recruiters look.

name: TikTok
description: A vertical feed of short videos tuned to your taste. Trends, music, comedy and how-tos in under a minute.

name: Pinterest
description: Visual discovery for recipes, home ideas, style and projects. Pin what you like to boards and come back to it later.

name: Discord
tagline: Voice, video and text for communities
description: Servers with text and voice channels for friends, gaming groups and communities. Works in the browser with no install.

name: Spotify
description: Stream millions of songs and podcasts. Playlists, Discover Weekly and a web player that works anywhere.

name: Apple Music
description: The full Apple Music catalog in the browser, with lossless audio, curated playlists and radio.

name: SoundCloud
description: Tracks, remixes and mixes uploaded by artists themselves. The place to hear music before it's anywhere else.

name: BBC News
description: International reporting with regional editions, live coverage and in-depth features from the BBC's newsroom.

name: CNN
description: US and world headlines, politics, business and live video from CNN.

name: The New York Times
description: In-depth reporting and opinion, plus Wordle, the crossword and NYT Cooking under one subscription.

name: The Guardian
description: Reader-funded news from the UK with international editions. No paywall.

name: Hacker News
description: A plain list of links voted up by programmers and founders, with comment threads that are often better than the articles.

name: Amazon
description: Shop nearly anything with fast delivery, reviews and Prime perks. Orders, returns and subscriptions in one account.

name: eBay
description: Auctions and fixed-price listings for new, used and collectible items from sellers around the world.

name: Etsy
description: A marketplace for independent makers: handmade goods, vintage finds, craft supplies and custom orders.

name: Walmart
description: Grocery pickup and delivery plus the full store catalog online.

name: Target
description: Home, clothing, groceries and essentials with Drive Up, Order Pickup and same-day delivery.

name: Best Buy
description: Computers, phones, TVs, games and appliances, with store pickup and Geek Squad support.

name: Gmail
description: Email with powerful search, labels, spam filtering and tight integration with Calendar, Drive and Meet.

name: Google Drive
description: Cloud storage plus the Google office suite. Share a file or folder with a link and edit together in real time.

name: Google Calendar
description: Shared calendars, meeting invites, reminders and appointment scheduling.

name: Notion
description: Pages that can be notes, databases, task boards or a team wiki. Flexible blocks you arrange however you work.

name: Trello
description: Boards, lists and cards for tracking work. Drag cards across columns, add checklists, due dates and attachments.

name: Slack
description: Channels, threads, huddles and integrations for workplace communication.

name: Zoom
description: Video calls and webinars that work from the browser. Schedule, join and record meetings.

name: Dropbox
description: Sync folders across devices and share large files with links. Paper docs and request-files folders included.

name: GitHub
description: Repositories, pull requests, issues, Actions and Copilot. Where most open source lives.

name: Stack Overflow
description: The reference Q&A site for programmers. Answers are voted on and edited, so the top one is usually right.

name: MDN Web Docs
description: Mozilla's reference for HTML, CSS, JavaScript and browser APIs, with compatibility tables and examples.

name: Vercel
description: Git-connected hosting for web apps. Every push gets a preview URL and main deploys to production.

name: Supabase
description: A hosted Postgres database with auth, storage, realtime and edge functions, managed from one dashboard.

name: ChatGPT
description: Chat with OpenAI's models for writing, coding, research and analysis. Supports images, files and voice.

name: Claude
description: Anthropic's Claude for long documents, careful writing, coding and analysis. Projects keep context across chats.

name: Gemini
description: Google's AI assistant, connected to Search, Gmail, Drive and Maps when you want it to be.

name: Perplexity
description: An answer engine that searches the web and cites its sources inline, so you can check every claim.

name: Wikipedia
description: Millions of articles in hundreds of languages, written and edited by volunteers.

name: Google Maps
description: Directions for driving, transit, walking and cycling, plus reviews, hours and photos for places nearby.

name: Duolingo
description: Short, game-like lessons in dozens of languages. Streaks and leagues keep you coming back.

name: Khan Academy
description: Free courses from arithmetic to calculus, science, history and test prep, with practice exercises and videos.

name: PayPal
description: Pay online, send money to friends and get paid, without sharing card details with the other side.

name: Airbnb
description: Book homes, rooms and unique stays from hosts around the world, plus local experiences.
